subject: Can you extract data for time windows defined down to the minute rather than the hour?

messages.author: 8e3f15e1bb408cc8
messages.subject: Can you extract data for time windows defined down to the minute rather than the hour?
parts:
Dear Vincent

Thanks so much for creating GGIR and for making it available open source.


I have recently started working with physical activity data recorded using GENEActiv accelerometers. One of my tasks is to extract variables relating to specific time points within the data collection period and I’m hoping to be able to use GGIR to do this. However, reading the documentation, it looks as though the coding only allows data extraction on the hour – is it possible to alter the granularity here so that I can select time windows at the minute level?


Best wishes

Sarah Price

messages.author: 0ba6fa6f78e733b5
messages.subject: Re: Can you extract data for time windows defined down to the minute rather than the hour?
parts:
Hi Sarah,

I think you can do this with the time windows, e.g. to get 8:30 am - 3:15 pm the window would be (8.5,15.25). Another option is to generate the timestamped csv epoch files using epochvalues2csv in g.part2.

Best,
Alex

Thanks for your help with this - much appreciated. Would you set the time window using the argument 'qwindow' (assuming it allows non-integer values)?

Best wishes
Sarah

messages.author: 0ba6fa6f78e733b5
messages.subject: Re: Can you extract data for time windows defined down to the minute rather than the hour?
parts:
Yep, that's right Sarah. It will give you the qlevels and the ilevels over the specified time period. You an also specify the L5M5 time window.

Cheers,
Alex
